 Taylor Farms Backyard BBQ Chop Salad Kit sold at H-E-B recalled 
 The FDA said the recall is due to the potential for undeclared soy and tree nuts (almonds). 
 By Charles Nichelson • 
 Published 1 hour ago • 
 Updated 1 hour ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 FDA 
 Dallas-based Taylor Farms is recalling its 13.4 oz H-E-B Backyard BBQ Chop Salad kit. It may have undeclared soy and tree nuts, like almonds, which could cause serious allergic reactions if consumed.
 There have been no reported reactions to this product as of yet.
 Watch NBC 5 free wherever you are
   WATCH HERE 
 The product was distributed to H-E-B's in Texas and has a Best By date of Oct. 30, 2026. The recalled product is packaged in plastic bags. The product also has a Universal Product Code (UPC) of 041220300457.
 Customers should throw it out or return it to the store for a full refund.
 Create a free account with NBC 5 DFW to save articles and videos.
 LEARN MORE 
 Customers with questions may contact Taylor Farms at (855) 455-0098 Monday through Friday between 10 a.m. and 6 p.m. CST.
